C0151.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle 'Account Factory': Illegally Obtained Citizen Data Used to Register and 'Fatten' Accounts for Sale
C0151.summary: In April 2026, the Shanghai Municipal Public Security Bureau disclosed a case of illegally obtaining computer information system data. The Xuhui District public security cyber unit dismantled a criminal gang specialized in 'manufacturing, farming, and selling accounts.' Ringleader Zhang, together with Guo, Liang, and seven others, illegally obtained over 10,000 citizens' real-name ID records, used an 'all-purpose registration machine' to bulk-register popular game accounts, and ran automated scripts 24/7 to farm the accounts for virtual resources before selling them at premium prices, involving over 2 million yuan.
